input.evidence_text: Every morning for three weeks, Sarah Rimmer would call the hospital where her husband was fighting for his life in the hope of being told the father-of-two had simply made it through the night Lewis was in an induced coma after being knocked down by a Range Rover in the car park of a Sainsbury's store in Bolton, Greater Manchester - just moments after he bought a lottery ticket The doting father was airlifted to the Royal Preston Hospital where his family were told he had just a 30% chance of pulling through Lewis spent weeks on life support and had more than 40 hours of surgery, including the amputation of his left foot "For three weeks, I couldn't hear his voice, tell him about the girls or ask him for advice," said Sarah, reflecting on how life had changed one year on "The girls couldn't understand why we couldn't Facetime daddy."

His killer, Simon Richardson, struck Mr Mullins at the junction of Dunham Road and Warburton Lane in Partington, on April 20 this year Mr Mullins was then dragged underneath Richardson's Volvo for 2.2km - or 1.3 miles - before dying at the roadside on Wet Gate Lane in Lymm. input.evidence_text: Was Shabana Mahmood forced into a U-turn over her migrant reforms? The Home Secretary has watered down her plans to make foreign care workers wait 15 years for settlement. But was it down to her own sense of "fairness" or did she capitulate to other C On Monday afternoon, Shabana Mahmood addressed the Commons by discussing a deeply personal account of her own family’s migration to the UK 50 years ago from rural Kashmir “They came here knowing one thing above all else – that they would be treated fairly here,” she told Parliament. “They came from a place where power was often arbitrary and where the dice were always loaded. title: Oldham Council agrees interim Lead Member arrangements to strengthen governance and accountability

input.lead: Oldham Council has approved a new package of interim governance arrangements
input.summary: Oldham Council has approved a new package of interim governance arrangements
input.evidence_text: Oldham Council has approved a new package of interim governance arrangements. These measures are designed to strengthen democratic oversight, provide clear political leadership across key service areas and support transparent decision-making while the borough continues to work towards the appointment of a Council Leader and Cabinet. The arrangements were approved by Council on 16 September and include the creation of interim Lead Member and Deputy Lead Member roles aligned to the Council's four directorates. The arrangements form part of a wider governance framework developed following legal advice, engagement with the Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government, and discussions between political group leaders. Under the arrangements, Chief Executive Shelley Kipling will continue to exercise delegated executive powers, while Lead Members provide political oversight, advocacy and a visible link between residents, councillors and services. The roles carry no executive decision-making powers. The four Interim Lead Member portfolios have been allocated to the Council's four largest political groups, with deputy roles assigned from the same groups. Interim Lead Member appointments Resources - Lead Member: Sam Al-Hamdani (Liberal Democrats) - Deputy Lead Member: Mark Kenyon (Liberal Democrats) The Resources portfolio will provide political oversight of the Council's finances, budget management, transformation programme, corporate services, governance, workforce and organisational performance. Founded in 1597, Wigan Grammar School taught countless pupils in a history spanning almost four centuries and served as one of the town’s oldest continuously operating institu On Wednesday 28th October, a selection of former pupils, Wigan Council and Wrightington, Wigan, and Leigh NHS Trust representatives attended the unveiling of the blue plaque at the Thomas Linacre Centre, which housed the school from 1937 until its closure in 1972. Councillor Chri “This blue plaque is a fitting recognition of the school’s remarkable legacy, ensuring that its story is remembered and celebrated for years to come.” Gaining a reputation for excellence that persisted through the centuries, Wigan Grammar School’s pupils have been represented in fields as diverse as neurology, print making, engineering and nuclear energy Some famous alumni include acclaimed composer Sir Ernest Bullock as well as actor Sir Ian McKellen

Audiences are free to choose their own path – with pop-up encounters punctuating the action, bringing bodies together in dance, song and ritual Watch Fertility Rite , a fevered ritual where bodies writhe against the ground in a desperate call for fertility. Witness Massaging the Breast where women gesticulate over graves to awaken the earth. In Scaring the Gods , women bare themselves to the sky to banish storms. Listen Unafraid to push the boundaries of eroticism and performance art, Balkan Erotic Epic asks its audience a timeless question: What are our bodies truly for?

input.evidence_text: Bolton Car Boot Sale is one of the North West's biggest weekly boot sales, held in the hardstanding car park of the Macron Stadium (formerly Reebok), Burnden Way, Horwich, Bolton BL6 6JW. It runs every Sunday from February right through to December, drawing over 300 sellers and thousands of bargain hunters each week. Sellers can arrive and set up from 6:00 AM, with buyers welcomed in from 7:00 AM. Entry costs just £1 per car for buyers. Pitches for sellers are £14 for a car, £20 for a van and £3 for a trailer, with regular and corner pitches available on request. Bring exact change to keep the queue moving, and call organiser Andrew on 07470784644 for more details. Expect hundreds of stalls across the concrete hardstanding pitches, so it goes ahead in most weather. On-site you'll find a 5-star catering service, doughnuts and coffee, ice cream and desserts, a meat auction, fresh fruit and veg, plants, and retro sweet stalls. The sale is dog-friendly, has male and female toilets, ample parking, and kids' rides and bouncy castles to keep little ones entertained.
